issues.on_page: Collection fee - County Treasurer 7,840 (Debt Service Fund, under Current)
issues.issue: County treasurer collection fee is a tax collection cost, not debt interest; the statement-level line (disbursements[0]) puts the same label under general government. Function is inconsistent for the same label; defensible only as 'function of the fund'.

General Fund paying agent fees (warrant paying agent) classed as professional/contract services, while the DSF 'Fiscal agent fees' (detail[14]) is debt interest and fees. Same kind of cost, different object category; judgment call.
